PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the Planning Commission on items listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.
7:00 p.m. Council Chamber
CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
STAFF REPORT
SET MATTERS - PUBLIC HEARINGS
1)
The request for consideration and adoption of a Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND) in conjunction with a request for consideration and approval of a Zoning Variance to deviate from the minimum side and rear yard setback requirements, a Conditional Use Permit to allow recreational facility (indoor/outdoor soccer facility) use, and a Design Review to review the building architecture and site design. (Location: 14412 & 14424 Joanbridge Street; Applicant: Trinidad Campbell; Case Number: ZV-23-01, CP 23-05, PR 23-21).
a.
Conduct a public hearing.
b.
An Initial Study/Mitigated Negative Declaration has been prepared. The Initial Study/MND properly discloses that the environmental effects from the project would be less than significant with the incorporation of standard conditions and mitigation measures pursuant to the CEQA Guidelines Section 15063; and
c.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-29 approving Mitigated Negative Declaration “A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK RECOMMENDING THAT THE PLANNING COMMISSION ADOPT A MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION AND A MITIGATION MONITORING AND REPORTING PROGRAM”; AND
d.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-28 APPROVING CP 23-05, ZV 23-01, and PR 23-21 “A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK RECOMMENDING CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF A ZONING VARIANCE TO DEVIATE FROM THE MINIMUM SIDE AND REAR YARD SETBACK REQUIREMENTS, A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW RECREATIONAL FACILITY (INDOOR/OUTDOOR SOCCER FACILITY) USE, AND A DESIGN REVIEW TO REVIEW THE BUILDING ARCHITECTURE AND SITE DESIGN
STAFF REPORT
2)
The request for consideration for approval of a conditional use permit to allow the operation of a food processing facility within an existing 93, 620-square foot multi-tenant building. The project is located within the (I), Industrial Zone, pursuant to Section 153.070.020 of the City’s Municipal Code (Location: 5119 Azusa Canyon Rd. Applicant: Ming Yu Tsai- Isabelle Gourmet Delicacies (IGD); Case Number: CP 23-09).
a.
Conduct a public hearing.
b.
Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15301 (Existing Facilities) as the project consists of adding a food processing facility to an existing tenant space.
c.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-27 approving “A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALWDIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR A FOOD PROCESSING FACILITY WITHIN AN EXISTING BUILDING, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 IN THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION 5119 AZUSA CANYON RD. APPLICANT: MING YU TSAI – ISABELLE GOURMET DELICACIES; CASE NUMBER: CP 23-09).
STAFF REPORT
NON PUBLIC HEARING ITEMS
1)
Gerneral Plan Conformance Report for the Proposed Vacation of an Alley Between Bogart Avenue and Downing Avenue.
a.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-30 "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, CALIFORNIA, FINDING THE VACATION OF AN ALLEY BETWEEN BOGAQRT AVENUE AND DOWNING AVENUE IN CONFORMANCE WITH THE GENERAL PLAN"
STAFF REPORT
REPORTS OF OFFICERS
COMMISSION/STAFF COMMUNICATIONS:
ADJOURNMENT
CERTIFICATION
I, Ron Garcia, Planning Commission Secretary hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
PLEASE NOTE: Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to each item on this agenda are available for public viewing and inspection at City Hall, 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, 2nd Floor Lobby Area or at the Los Angeles County Public Library in the City of Baldwin Park, 4181 Baldwin Park Blvd. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the Planning Department at 626.813-5261 or via e-mail to rgarcia@baldwinpark.com
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the Public Works Department or Risk Management at 626.960.4011. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable staff to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 34.102.104 ADA TITLE II)
